expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: Brand `FromAccountId` and `ToAccountId` so callers cannot silently swap the two string arguments

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: Stripe may have charged successfully even though this process never received the response... the recursive retry issues a second charge... require an `IdempotencyKey`

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: it returns `null`, erasing whether the payment was declined, failed, or actually succeeded remotely. Callers can proceed on a plausible but false result

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: JavaScript `number` is binary floating point; `price` and balances can accrue rounding errors, while `amountCents` is not verified as an integer minor-unit amount

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: use a closed `SubscriptionStatus` union plus `assertNever` exhaustiveness

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: send arbitrary JSON... There is no Stripe signature verification, schema validation, or idempotency

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: Mistakes framed as actions: 'send arbitrary JSON', 'retry after a timeout', 'call `purgeCanceledAccounts()` without a cutoff', 'call `updateSubscription(id, "past_due")`'

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Top 4 findings: webhook charge, retry charge, transfer atomicity, account deletion; all money-movement or irreversible categories ranked highest

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Each device specifies exact controls: 'verify signature against raw request body', 'reserve in database row with unique constraint', 'one database transaction with findUniqueOrThrow', 'Brand FromAccountId and ToAccountId'
